works.title: Tokopedia's Product Launching Platform
works.description: Built a cross-platform design system used across Shopee, Garena, and SeaMoney.

columns.html: Overview
A Project to create a self-serve product launching platform that helps sellers/brand to create their own campaign on their shop.
Objective
The main objective is how to create a seamless platform that sellers can use to make their process of product launching campaign simpler and easier.
🎉 Outcome
An end to end self serve product launching platform is now available to the selected seller in Tokopedia
Bring x times (confidential) higher traffic to brands & Tokopedia as a platform compared to the usual Flash Sale campaign
Total of thousands of products sold out in an (x mins - confidential) in a single campaign
👩‍💻 My Role
Main User Experience Designer for this project
Co-assist a co-design session which involved ~20 people from different function (Business, Product, Engineer, Data Analyst) to help align our vision for the product.
Collaborate and worked together with PMs, Engineer, UI Designer to help bring the design to life
Designed the end to end journey and user flow on the seller's end
Conducted user testing & user in-depth interview on end to end journey.
⚡️ Behind The Product
Project Background
In the first quarter of 2020, Tokopedia has been given the opportunity to work together with some of the most highly requested official brands.

The collaboration was formed to provide these brands with a reliable online platform to launch their products. Considering that the products that they launch have always been a huge hit among collectors and fans of the brand & public, where they usually only lasted 10 - 30 mins before all the products sold out. This collaboration has successfully increased traffic and conversion for both parties.
After the big success of launching and partnering with these brands, we receive a surge in interest from other brands to also have a product launch on our platform.
Key Problem
The sudden surge of interest from brands also comes with some challenges that we need to solve. Since the first iteration of Tokopedia's product launching has to be done manually:

Long time to process and a campaign request from brands A brand needs to wait for several days to launch their product due to manual operational effort. This makes the platform isn't scalable for future business opportunities with brands.
Can’t run multiple launching brands at the same time Since it was done manually, the process will take up too many people & effort to run.

There's a special request from brands to have specific terms and condition An example of this use case is many brands needed to limit/give exclusivity for some of their campaigns. With this request, there's an additional couple of hours for the operational team to validate this rule.

There's no specific entry point where sellers can request to create their product launching campaign Currently, sellers would have to manually reach out to our internal team to request this type of campaign.

intro: I'm Nadya Arizka a product designer based in Singapore with 9 years of experience in product design.

I have developed a passion for user interface and user experience design. I've always enjoyed engaging with people and discovering the secrets to people's relationships with technology which attracted me to learn more about user experience and fell in love with it more each day.
I received a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology. As an IT graduate, knowing basic knowledge about product development has helped me to understand the feasibility of products that I design.
